We mix the parts that make up the whole

Our Group

Design & Build

We pride ourselves in creating beautiful and functional spaces that reflect the unique personalities and lifestyles of our clients. As a full-service interior design firm with a team of highly skilled professionals, we specialize in every aspect of interior design from initial consultations to concept development, space planning, color schemes selection and project management.

Aluminum

Specialized in aluminum construction. with a commitment to innovation and quality enabled us to apply the new standards in the industry for both performance and reliability. ARCH utilizes cutting-edge manufacturing processes that enable us to produce products that are tailored specifically to meet our customers needs.

Mooka

At Mooka, our expert engineers and technicians craft furniture using state-of-the-art technology, ensuring unmatched quality and durability. Our in-house design team—specializing in interior architecture, woodcraft, and 3D visualization—creates bespoke designs tailored to each client’s needs.

Wooden

Our experienced engineers and technicians use state-of-the-art machines to craft and manufacture all of our products in accordance with strict standards for quality and durability. In addition, our in-house design team is composed of experts from various disciplines such as interior architecture, wooden works, furniture design and computer aided visualization which allows us to create unique designs tailored specifically for each customer's needs.

Tshatib

A prominent Saudi supply company in its industry. The integrated online store offers a comprehensive range of products necessary for construction, finishing, and renovation projects. We offer sophisticated, premium merchandise sourced from top-tier global manufacturers, accompanied by an assurance that safeguards your purchase against any potential flaws.

MEP

Our team of experts is highly skilled and experienced in all aspects of MEP design and installation. We understand that every project is unique, so we offer customized solutions to meet the specific needs of our clients. From HVAC systems installation to electrical wiring or plumbing installation – no matter what your requirements may be – you can count on us for safe, efficient solutions at competitive prices.

ABOUT US

WHY ARCH

Arch is a leading holding company that specializes in providing comprehensive services related to construction and building materials.Our team have years of experience in the industry and are dedicated to delivering high-quality products and services while also offering customized solutions tailored specifically for our clients’ needs.

Anticipate Solution

With our ability to foresee solutions, we meticulously plan every aspect of our projects and significantly reduce risks and uncertainties in the entire production process.

To Detail
With our expertise in logistics,installation, and assembly, we have the capability to closely monitor even the most minute aspects.
All Kind of Material

Our industries enable us to create various types of material and apply cutting-edge techniques to enhance its quality and innovation.

Trust

Our clients can rest assured knowing that we prioritize their security by meticulously monitoring every project both before and after its completion.

Get to know

Trusted Partners and Valued Clients

Case Studies

Projects

We rely on our family members to collaborate on a project, drawing from our collective expertise across various fields and project types.
